description.zh:
镜像族系名称。

自定义镜像、公共镜像、社区镜像、共享镜像均已支持镜像族系，使用方法及介绍请参见[镜像族系概述](~~174241~~)。
description.en:
The family name of the image that you want to use to create the instances.

You can configure image families for custom images, public images, community images, and shared images. For more information, see [Overview of image families](~~174241~~).

description.zh: 镜像所在的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The ID of the region in which to create the custom image. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

title.zh: 查询镜像族系内可用镜像

descriptions.zh:
## 接口说明

指定查询的镜像族系如果不存在可用的镜像，则返回结果为空。
descriptions.en:
## [](#)Usage notes

If no available image exists in a specific image family, the response is empty.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs describe-image-from-family --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --image-family hangzhou-daily-update --region cn-hangzhou
